title: Na Pali Riders
specs: Due to the nature of the Nā Pali Raft & Snorkel Adventure, you must be ready to experience ADVENTURE ON THE SEA!

includes: Reminder If you feel that our crew has provided exceptional service after your tour, you’re welcome to show your appreciation with a gratuity.

blurb: Embark on a thrilling journey along Kauai’s Nā Pali Coast with our Zodiac Raft Tour. Experience the inspiring landscape, with a likely chance of Hawaiian Spinner dolphins.
tags: NĀ PALI COAST SEA CAVES RAFT EXPEDITION + SNORKEL
NĀ PALI COAST SEA CAVES RAFT EXPEDITION (MAY - SEPTEMBER ONLY)
extraNote: Tip: The 6:30am/7:00am departure is our most popular tour due to the lighter wind conditions, calmer waters, and more dolphin encounters. · If you are not checked in at least 30 minutes before departure with your waivers signed, you risk missing the tour with no refund. · Late arrivals who miss the safety briefing are subject to missing the tour with no refund. · We recommend booking early in your vacation in case of a weather cancellation, then you have more time to rebook. · Within 14 days of tour date, the total amount of the private charter becomes non-refundable. · Gift card sales are final and non-refundable.
